scope: Focused primary-source review for the Performance table; not an exhaustive census or citation-count ranking. Selection prioritizes methodological fit and includes early work.

selected.name: FoT
selected.relevance: Distills local reasoning insights into a shared library; studies transfer across task domains.
selected.limits: Keeping raw trajectories local is not a formal privacy guarantee.

selected.name: Multiagent Debate
selected.relevance: Agents critique and revise candidate answers over communication rounds.
selected.limits: Consensus need not imply correctness; first preprint appeared in 2023.

selected.name: Mixture-of-Agents
selected.relevance: Successive layers synthesize previous agents' responses.
selected.limits: Heterogeneous models do not by themselves establish robustness to non-IID task distributions.

selected.name: MASS
selected.relevance: Optimizes prompts and workflow topology, including aggregation and debate blocks.
selected.limits: A system-design method rather than a standalone aggregation rule; first preprint 2025, ICLR 2026.

selected.name: Social Learning
selected.relevance: Teachers transfer knowledge from private datasets using generated instructions or synthetic examples.
selected.limits: Evidence for distributed knowledge transfer, not a general solution or theoretical guarantee for non-IID tasks.

selected.name: iAgents
selected.relevance: Coordinates agents that have access to different local user information.
selected.limits: Information asymmetry is related to, but distinct from, statistical heterogeneity in training.

selected.name: MAEL
selected.relevance: Retrieves task-relevant experience from agent-specific pools.
selected.limits: Supports task/agent specialization; does not establish user-preference personalization.

selected.name: LEGOMem
selected.relevance: Allocates procedural memories across orchestrators and task agents.
selected.limits: Role-aware memory allocation rather than a formal personalized optimization objective; cite original preprint.

selected.name: ShareMem
selected.relevance: Shares reusable experience while consulting the receiving user's own preferences.
selected.limits: Recent preprint marked work in progress; selected for direct fit, not citation count.

selected.name: FedAvg
selected.relevance: Alternates local model updates and central aggregation.
selected.limits: Text synthesis is an analogy to parameter aggregation, not arithmetic averaging of strings.

selected.name: FedDF
selected.relevance: Distills client ensemble predictions into a server model using unlabeled inputs.
selected.limits: A proposed inspiration for text-output synthesis; the original method trains model parameters.

selected.name: IFCA
selected.relevance: Alternates client clustering and optimization of cluster-specific models.
selected.limits: Task-compatibility grouping for agents is proposed here; the original convergence assumptions do not automatically hold.

selected.name: Ditto
selected.relevance: Maintains global and personalized models with local regularization toward the global model.
selected.limits: Separating shared and local agent memory is a design analogy; no inherited convergence or robustness theorem is claimed.

other_papers_screened.name: AutoGen
other_papers_screened.selection_note: General conversation framework; less direct than selected papers for these three mechanisms.

other_papers_screened.name: MetaGPT
other_papers_screened.selection_note: Role-based workflow; role assignment alone is not personalized adaptation.

other_papers_screened.name: CAMEL
other_papers_screened.selection_note: Early role-playing collaboration; useful background, less direct challenge-specific evidence.

other_papers_screened.name: Encouraging Divergent Thinking through Multi-Agent Debate
other_papers_screened.selection_note: Close aggregation alternative; selected Du et al. to avoid multiple similar debate citations.

other_papers_screened.name: AFlow
other_papers_screened.selection_note: Workflow search; MASS retained to cover the user's explicit suggestion.

other_papers_screened.name: Intrinsic Memory Agents
other_papers_screened.selection_note: Close alternative for role-aligned agent memory; selected papers cover task, role, and user specificity.

other_papers_screened.name: Collaborative Multi-Agent Optimization for Personalized Memory System
other_papers_screened.selection_note: Memory-maintenance-agent optimization; less direct than ShareMem for shared versus user-specific knowledge.

other_papers_screened.name: FedAgent
other_papers_screened.selection_note: Examines heterogeneous agent reinforcement learning with parameter updates; outside the table's primary text-space focus.

other_papers_screened.name: Federated Multi-Task Learning (MOCHA)
other_papers_screened.selection_note: Earlier personalized/related-task optimization alternative; Ditto offers a simpler explicit global/local analogy.

other_papers_screened.name: Context Language Models
other_papers_screened.selection_note: User clarified CLM refers to this paper, but prefers an unidentified alternative by Yang Wang; awaiting title/link.

proposed_connections: FedAvg/FedDF to synthesis, IFCA to selective sharing, and Ditto to shared/local memory are author-proposed design connections, not claims that these agent systems implement the original algorithms or inherit their guarantees.
